endorsements.quote: There was broad agreement that validation requirements should be proportional to clinical risk, with strong support for real-world data—particularly for AI systems—alongside controlled studies.
Human–AI collaboration is essential; clinical responsibility ultimately remains with the clinician.
CE is most valuable when applied selectively, not universally.

unlisted_practices: Develop standardized ground truth definitions for AI tools in capsule endoscopy.
Establish standardized quality indicators and metrics for capsule endoscopy pathways, including post-CCE colorectal cancer definitions.
Generate robust cost-effectiveness evidence before wider adoption of capsule endoscopy.
Progress capsule technologies along technology-readiness levels through close clinician–engineer collaboration.

screen.reason: Conference report summarizing multidisciplinary discussions and recommendations on the future integration, validation, and safeguards for capsule endoscopy and AI diagnostic tools in gastroenterology.
